verdict.rationale: Activepieces exposes a documented REST API with API-key/Bearer auth (activepieces-docs-2, activepieces-docs-28, activepieces-docs-33) and a built-in MCP server explicitly marketed as being able to 'build flows, manage tables, test automations' and 'drive the whole platform' via natural language (activepieces-docs-4, activepieces-docs-27), suggesting broad UI/API parity for AI-native use. However, there is no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (activepieces-probe-3) or independent confirmation that every UI action (e.g., publishing approvals, embedding provisioning, agent tool governance) is fully API/MCP-accessible. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint coverage, and independent/hands-on verification that all UI workflows (not just flow-building) are API-equivalent.
